text_blocks.snippet: The accuracy of at-home COVID-19 tests varies depending on the specific test, the manufacturer, and the individual user.
According to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), most at-home tests have a sensitivity of around 80% and a specificity of over 95%. This means that:

list.snippet: 80% of people who have COVID-19 will test positive.
95% of people who do not have COVID-19 will test negative.

text_blocks.snippet: However, it's important to note that:

list.snippet: Test accuracy can be lower if the test is not used correctly or if the user has a low viral load.
